name: session-compass
description: Session Compass: a band above the Claude Code prompt that tells what the session is about (a one-line summary of your prompts so far, made again after each prompt or on 🔁) and has buttons to step back and forth through your prompts and Claude's replies to them (or your prompts alone); the summary shows above Claude's question dialog too, at the band's width; output blocks fold with a ▼/▶ marker or all at once with 📖/📕 on the band, and the prompt or reply a button lands on is marked with ▌

summaryMode.title: Summary mode
summaryMode.description: auto: remake the band's summary after each prompt. manual: make it once, then only when 🔁 on the band is pressed.

navTarget.title: Navigation target
navTarget.description: all: the band's 🔼/🔽 stop at your prompts and at Claude's replies after each (its text blocks). prompts: they stop at your prompts only.
